profile.headline: Software Engineer at Varian Medical Systems
profile.summary:
Object Oriented Analysis, Design, and Development

• Innovative software engineer offering 8 years of experience in full software development cycle – from concept through delivery.
• Excellent troubleshooting skills – able to analyze code and engineer well-researched solutions for customer needs.   
• Adaptability allows hitting the ground running on five software development projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Key contributor to software high level design and detailed design of new development.
• Developed software using Agile methodology for faster responses to customer needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Key contributor to software high level design and detailed design of new development.
• Developed software using Agile methodology for faster responses to customer needs.
• Resolved multi-threading concurrency issues in software that accesses common data.
• Refactored search and filter software with Java web service calls and enhanced performance with improved data structures.
• Reworked and dramatically improved the performance of .NET Application data updates.
• Critical software development experience on three design phases, four code phase, five software integration test phases, and extensive experience in upgrades and maintenance efforts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Improved a large distributed system with enhancements while obtaining skills in JMS and Swing.
• Experience developing and maintaining a large and complex multi-server and multi-workstation based distributed system with service-oriented architecture.
• Extensive experience with work travel, easily adapts to new situations, locations, and people.

positions.title: Software Engineer Associate
positions.description:
• Developed firmware and Graphical User Interface (GUI) in C, C++, and C# based on the Firmware
Design.
• Assisted in the redesign of the firmware and associated GUI.

honors.title: General Dynamics Excellence Award
honors.description: General Dynamics Excellence Award for key contribution in completion of mission critical system.
honors.issuer: Issued by General Dynamics Mission Systems · May 2016
